title: A bench frame, cervical, decided by the caption
caption: A cervical panel whose levels its caption decided, as a reader sees it on the bench.

source.notes: One of the 120 panel images the bench ships in its img/ folder, copied as it is; the bench page records for it the panel path, the decoded levels with their confidences and which evidence decided them. Three were taken as representatives, one per region.
